let r50_two_point_vector = fn(index N+: index <= 2) R

prop r50_is_probability_vector2(p r50_two_point_vector):
    p(1) >= 0
    p(2) >= 0
    p(1) + p(2) = 1

have fn r50_expectation2(values, probs r50_two_point_vector) R = values(1) * probs(1) + values(2) * probs(2)

have fn r50_variance2(values, probs r50_two_point_vector) R = (values(1) - r50_expectation2(values, probs))^2 * probs(1) + (values(2) - r50_expectation2(values, probs))^2 * probs(2)

have fn r50_fair_coin_values(k N+: k <= 2) R = k - 1

have fn r50_fair_coin_probs(k N+: k <= 2) R = 1 / 2

r50_fair_coin_probs $in r50_two_point_vector
r50_fair_coin_values $in r50_two_point_vector
r50_fair_coin_probs(1) = 1 / 2
r50_fair_coin_probs(2) = 1 / 2
r50_fair_coin_values(1) = 0
r50_fair_coin_values(2) = 1
by def $r50_is_probability_vector2(r50_fair_coin_probs)

r50_expectation2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs) = r50_fair_coin_values(1) * r50_fair_coin_probs(1) + r50_fair_coin_values(2) * r50_fair_coin_probs(2)
r50_fair_coin_values(1) * r50_fair_coin_probs(1) + r50_fair_coin_values(2) * r50_fair_coin_probs(2) = 0 * (1 / 2) + 1 * (1 / 2) = 1 / 2
r50_expectation2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs) = 1 / 2

r50_variance2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs) = (r50_fair_coin_values(1) - r50_expectation2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs))^2 * r50_fair_coin_probs(1) + (r50_fair_coin_values(2) - r50_expectation2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs))^2 * r50_fair_coin_probs(2)
(r50_fair_coin_values(1) - r50_expectation2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs))^2 * r50_fair_coin_probs(1) + (r50_fair_coin_values(2) - r50_expectation2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs))^2 * r50_fair_coin_probs(2) = (0 - 1 / 2)^2 * (1 / 2) + (1 - 1 / 2)^2 * (1 / 2)
(0 - 1 / 2)^2 * (1 / 2) + (1 - 1 / 2)^2 * (1 / 2) = 1 / 4
r50_variance2(r50_fair_coin_values, r50_fair_coin_probs) = 1 / 4
